reader_summary.headline: Ricky Sandler, founder, CEO, and CIO of Eminence Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Ricky Sandler, founder, CEO, and CIO of Eminence Capital. Starting with stories from his upbringing and early career. He shares insights from navigating the 1998 crisis, outlines the value of rigorous risk management. The conversation also delves into quant integration, thoughtful activism, the nuances of portfolio construction, and his reflections on AI, market structure.
